description:
A thrilling 19+ romance about people who sign up for a lover (unrequited love) service to overcome the pain of heartbreak! The main character, Ji-Soo, hears from her crush, Yoon-Hoo, that he has a girlfriend he's going to marry, and falls into despair when she realizes that their relationship was all just a delusion. Ji-Soo, who can't forget Yoon-Hoo and masturbates out of loneliness, accidentally remembers a "lover service" commercial on TV, signs up for the service in a fit of anger, and falls asleep. The next day, a handsome man comes to Ji-Soo's house like a lie...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
